claims.research_fact: KTGAL is a GA-adapted KT2440 derivative; deleting C at genomic position 2867088 repairs galT, yielding 449 aa rather than the reported inactive 522-aa GalT*.
claims.source_locator: Results: Identification of the gal cluster; Table1; FN669140.1
claims.disposition: Exact repaired sequence separately proved; current KT2440 pseudo-gene does not reconstruct the inactive allele.

claims.research_fact: pIZGalT carrying corrected KTGAL galT restores GA uptake and growth in KT2440; multicopy expression increases GA and protocatechuate uptake.
claims.source_locator: Results: GalT transporter; Figure2A-B; publisher lines214-225
claims.scope: Whole cells and multicopy corrected allele
claims.disposition: Do not transfer repaired allele identity to the 2023 KT2440-derived construct.

claims.research_fact: Reported uptake Vmax/Km are GA 8.4 nmol/min/mg and 4.3 uM; protocatechuate 3.2 and 9.1 uM. Figure2B caption describes GA-induced KTGAL; adjacent prose discusses pIZGalT.
claims.disposition: Retain numeric context; no new visual confirmation; do not silently assign every parameter to multicopy preparation.

claims.research_fact: No transport detected for homogentisate, caffeate, 4-hydroxybenzoate, methyl gallate, syringate or pyrogallol in the stated specificity assay.
claims.source_locator: Results line225; Experimental procedures: transport assays
claims.disposition: No universal substrate-exclusion claim; catechol appears in methods but is not explicitly among result negatives.

claims.research_fact: FCCP30uM, CCCP20uM and 2,4-dinitrophenol1mM inhibit GA uptake.
